fkt_owned_semantics: committed state is physical trial origin
fsi_owned_implementation: Newton vectors and nonlinear iteration internals

integration_rule.kernel_side: kernel_model_t remains the F-KT model seam used by the transaction substrate
integration_rule.solver_side: a production kernel_model_t implementation may delegate soil-water work to an F-SI-owned service
integration_rule.reason: F-KT01 does not need to prescribe Richards internals; defining a soil-solver service type now would pre-empt F-SI ownership

fsi_must_not: change checkpoint, committed, candidate, commit or rollback meaning
replace generic t0,t1 with calendar-day semantics
insert worker scratch into persistent column state
expose HeadCalc, Newton or Jacobian arrays through the kernel contract
create a competing canonical kernel entrypoint
fkt_must_not: inspect or depend on HeadCalc internal arrays
select a specific Richards implementation as a kernel invariant
change solver physics to satisfy transaction tests

minimum_solver_facing_behavior_visible_t.physical_trial: advance dynamic trial state over an arbitrary t0,t1 and return trial outcome/accounting through the existing generic transaction model seam
minimum_solver_facing_behavior_visible_t.storage: return unrounded physical storage required by transaction mass accounting
minimum_solver_facing_behavior_visible_t.temporal_comparison: return temporal error according to an independently qualified numerical policy
minimum_solver_facing_behavior_visible_t.attempt_context: capture/restore worker-local attempt context without placing it in column state

shared_contract_change_protocol: define the minimum shared contract first
do not create parallel competing definitions
